keys.description: crm-api's own Postgres login (`postgresql+pg8000://<CRM_DB_USER>:<CRM_DB_PASSWORD>@host/db`), the role `python -m crm.migrate init` made: never a superuser, grants on the crm_* tables only. crm-api refuses any other driver, a superuser and any other schema version (`migrate.check`). The outbox (`python -m crm.outbox --watch`) and `crm.migrate check|migrate` log in with it too

the one organisation this install's CRM serves (ADR-0047), never chosen by a caller. `crm.migrate init` creates it with its entity types; with `personal_crm` on, an individual is served from their org of one instead

identity's internal door: every caller is resolved by `/internal/validate`, and with `personal_crm` on each person's home org by `GET /internal/users/{id}/org`. No host-port default: a deployment default names the service and lives in the deploy surface

the internal tier's secret: presented to identity on every caller resolution and to agent-api on the desk-limits read, and the credential crm-api's own /internal routes require. A published placeholder is refused outright (F95)

keys.default: (empty — the release default: the CRM and every other unproven feature off)
keys.description: the unproven features this deployment switches on, by agent-api's `install_defaults` rules: `crm` (or `all`) serves the CRM, `personal_crm` must be named explicitly (`all` does not switch it on). Switched off, every CRM route answers the typed `refused` body
agent-api's door, where crm-api reads `_global/POLICIES.md` for the desk's limits with the internal secret (narrow-only, cached 30 s). Unset or unreachable, the defaults apply

flows' address — the domain the outbox (`python -m crm.outbox --watch`) HANDS each revision's fact to (`POST /events`, one fact per revision, stable event id so redelivery dedupes). A publish, not a dependency: unset is the no-flows profile, the outbox answers `Flows is not configured` and the rows stay pending; crm-api never reads it
flows' operator key (the value flows reads as VEXA_FLOWS_API_KEY), sent by the outbox as `X-Flows-Operator-Key` on `POST /events`. Unset, the outbox delivers nothing and the rows stay pending

the secret event.v2 fact envelopes are sealed under (PRD 0.13.4 D8): the outbox seals each card fact with the `crm` producer key derived from it (`fact_envelope.producer_key`), bound to the event type, event id and refs it is posted with. It must equal flows-api's value, or flows refuses the fact 403 and the row stays pending. Its own credential, never the internal tier's: the outbox refuses to start without it
`crm.migrate init` only: the database host it connects to with the admin credential to create the CRM's role and tables
`crm.migrate init` only: the database the crm_* tables live in, and the one the CRM's role is granted CONNECT on (the chart also composes CRM_DATABASE_URL from it)
`crm.migrate init` only: the admin role that creates the CRM's role. crm-api and the outbox never hold it
`crm.migrate init` only: the admin role's password. crm-api and the outbox never hold it
`crm.migrate init` only: the name of the CRM's own login role it creates (or re-asserts)
`crm.migrate init`: the password it sets on the CRM's role. The chart also composes CRM_DATABASE_URL from it
`crm.migrate init` only: the display name of the organisation it creates
`crm.migrate check` only: how long it waits, as the CRM's role, for the schema to exist before giving up

fact_seal_key.description: The seal secret for event.v2 fact envelopes (D8): the crm outbox seals each card fact's audience so it reaches the people the card names, not only its subject.
fact_seal_key.when_unconfigured: The outbox refuses to start (`VEXA_FACT_SEAL_SECRET is required`), so no fact leaves the CRM and the outbox rows stay pending. crm-api itself serves as before.
